A map with two maps to compare, left and right, a config map and a list of numbers. Awk programs beside the calls use the functions that silt__run loads ahead of every program. same.awk uses tree_equal: it prints, for each member of left, whether right has the same value under that name. The members show that two numbers written differently are the same, that a map in another order is the same and a list in another order is not, and that a null and a missing member are the same. edited.awk uses tree_edit: it prints the document with a value replaced, a value added, a map created under a name, a node copied under another name, and elements appended to a list. totals.awk uses tree_edit and numbers together: it adds the sum and the mean of the numbers to the document, one written as an int and one as a float.
